entries.text: Seven gates stand between you and the scale. Each has three who mind it. One calls, one watches, one keeps.

alignment.characters: Seven gates stand between you and the scale. Each has three who mind it. One calls, one watches, one keeps.

entries.text: I can give you the first gate. I cannot give you the others.

alignment.characters: I can give you the first gate. I cannot give you the others.

entries.text: You have read it. Now it is read over you.

alignment.characters: You have read it. Now it is read over you.

entries.text: Take this. It is empty. Every soul who walks the Duat writes its own road.

alignment.characters: Take this. It is empty. Every soul who walks the Duat writes its own road.

entries.text: So is every road, before it is walked.

alignment.characters: So is every road, before it is walked.

entries.text: That one is Sad of Voice. He announces everyone the same way. Do not take it to heart.

alignment.characters: That one is Sad of Voice. He announces everyone the same way. Do not take it to heart.

entries.text: Speak a name in the Duat and its owner must answer. Try his.

alignment.characters: Speak a name in the Duat and its owner must answer. Try his.

entries.text: He hears everything. That is his work.

alignment.characters: He hears everything. That is his work.

entries.text: It does not need one written. Face-downward, Numerous of Shapes. You have met.

alignment.characters: It does not need one written. Face-downward, Numerous of Shapes. You have met.

entries.text: A gate is not opened by force. It is opened by being known.

alignment.characters: A gate is not opened by force. It is opened by being known.

entries.text: They forgot.

alignment.characters: They forgot.

entries.text: The worker stopped, and you remembered. That is the whole of Wernes.

alignment.characters: The worker stopped, and you remembered. That is the whole of Wernes.

entries.text: Your field is still waiting.

alignment.characters: Your field is still waiting.

entries.text: Here the dead are given fields. This one is yours. It is waiting.

alignment.characters: Here the dead are given fields. This one is yours. It is waiting.

entries.text: In the old tongue the word is wen. In yours, open. Say it to what is shut.

alignment.characters: In the old tongue the word is wen. In yours, open. Say it to what is shut.

entries.text: Then something must carry it. Your worker sleeps on its feet. Res. Wake.

alignment.characters: Then something must carry it. Your worker sleeps on its feet. Res. Wake.

entries.text: It does exactly what it is told. Nothing more.

alignment.characters: It does exactly what it is told. Nothing more.

entries.text: Every pour breaks the water. Look at the worker. It will never stop unless it is told.

alignment.characters: Every pour breaks the water. Look at the worker. It will never stop unless it is told.

entries.text: Hetep. Peace. The word is still.

alignment.characters: Hetep. Peace. The word is still.

entries.text: Not the water. What keeps breaking it?

alignment.characters: Not the water. What keeps breaking it?

entries.text: That word is not yours yet. The land will give it to you when you need it.

alignment.characters: That word is not yours yet. The land will give it to you when you need it.

entries.text: Here you are not required to labour.

alignment.characters: Here you are not required to labour.

entries.text: That is the question the land is asking.

alignment.characters: That is the question the land is asking.

entries.text: Nothing you know stops water. There is a word for it. You have been afraid of it a long time.

alignment.characters: Nothing you know stops water. There is a word for it. You have been afraid of it a long time.

entries.text: You know it exists. Your mouth will not make it. Ask the door on the wall why.

alignment.characters: You know it exists. Your mouth will not make it. Ask the door on the wall why.

entries.text: A shut door kept the night out of that house for years. Use the word for something small.

alignment.characters: A shut door kept the night out of that house for years. Use the word for something small.

entries.text: A seal is not only a wall. Sometimes it is a hand over a cup.

alignment.characters: A seal is not only a wall. Sometimes it is a hand over a cup.
